description: This file defines the Customer model class for the OpenCart e-commerce platform. It includes methods for creating, updating, retrieving, and deleting customer records and related data such as IPs, login attempts, authorizations, and tokens. The class is part of the 'Opencart\' namespace and extends the base engine model, indicating its role in interacting with the database for customer-related operations.

classes.name: Customer
classes.description: Represents the customer data and operations within the OpenCart system, including creation, updates, retrievals, and deletions of customer records as well as management of related entities such as IPs, login attempts, authorizations, and tokens.

methods.name: addCustomer
methods.description: Creates a new customer record in the database, assigning default or specified customer group and handling approval status.

methods.name: editCustomer
methods.description: Updates an existing customer's personal information by customer ID.

methods.name: editPassword
methods.description: Updates the password for a customer identified by email.

methods.name: editNewsletter
methods.description: Updates the newsletter subscription status for a customer.

methods.name: deleteCustomer
methods.description: Removes the customer record and related data such as activities, addresses, affiliate info, approval, rewards, transactions, wishlists, histories, IPs, and authorizations.

methods.name: getCustomer
methods.description: Retrieves detailed customer information by ID, decoding custom fields.

methods.name: getCustomerByEmail
methods.description: Fetches a customer's record using their email address.

methods.name: getTotalCustomersByEmail
methods.description: Counts the number of customer records with a specific email.

methods.name: deleteHistories
methods.description: Deletes all history records associated with a customer.

methods.name: deleteIps
methods.description: Removes all IP records linked to a customer.

methods.name: getIps
methods.description: Retrieves all IP address records for a customer.

methods.name: getTotalIps
methods.description: Counts the total IP records for a customer.

methods.name: addLogin
methods.description: Logs a customer login with IP and country information.

methods.name: addLoginAttempt
methods.description: Records a login attempt for a customer email.

methods.name: deleteLoginAttempts
methods.description: Clears login attempt records for a specific email.

methods.name: getLoginAttempts
methods.description: Retrieves login attempt details for an email.

methods.name: addAuthorize
methods.description: Creates an authorization token record for a customer.

methods.name: editAuthorizeStatus
methods.description: Updates the active/inactive status of a customer authorization.

methods.name: editAuthorizeTotal
methods.description: Sets the total number of authorization attempts for a customer.

methods.name: deleteAuthorizes
methods.description: Removes authorization records for a customer, optionally by authorize ID.

methods.name: deleteAuthorizeByToken
methods.description: Deletes an authorization record identified by customer ID and token.

methods.name: getAuthorizeByToken
methods.description: Fetches authorization details by customer ID and token, including total attempts.

methods.name: resetAuthorizes
methods.description: Resets total authorization attempts for a customer.

methods.name: addToken
methods.description: Creates a token record for a customer of a specific type.

methods.name: deleteTokenByCode
methods.description: Deletes a token record identified by its code.

methods.name: getTokenByCode
methods.description: Retrieves token details by code, also deleting expired tokens.
